key_findings: KVLink (arXiv 2502.16002) is the definitive solution for position-independent KV-cache reuse: 96% TTFT reduction, 4% accuracy improvement via RoPE decoupling + trainable link tokens

RoPE (Rotary Position Embeddings) position encoding fundamentally couples cached K/V to their precomputation position; KVLink solves by storing position-free K/V and re-applying RoPE at inference time
Link tokens (trainable cross-segment connectors, K=5 default) append to each precomputed chunk; enable cross-document attention recovery during inference with negligible computational cost

Position-Independent Caching (PIC) ecosystem mature: EPIC (2024) formalizes compile-and-link paradigm; MEPIC (2025) production-ready with fused RoPE kernel; supports chunk reuse at arbitrary positions

Cross-layer KV fusion (FusedKV, C2C) addresses model architecture mismatches; C2C achieves 6-14% accuracy improvement cross-model and identifies layer-index mismatch as distinct from position mismatch

Layer-depth mismatch (source layer 11 → target layer 15) creates 10-30% accuracy degradation; terminal layer alignment (end-first) + learnable fusion partially mitigates; not yet fully solved in literature
Fine-tuning requirement: KVLink fine-tunes for link tokens (6000 steps on 8 H100s); C2C fine-tunes fuser only (frozen LLMs); zero-shot methods possible but 8-15% less accurate
Compression strategy: Pre-RoPE quantization (before position rotation) 30-40% better than post-RoPE; must sequence compression before KV transfer to avoid compounding lossy operations

sources.title: KVLink: Accelerating Large Language Models via Efficient KV Cache Reuse
sources.authors: Yang, Hou, Wei, Bao, Chang (UC Santa Barbara + Accenture)
sources.relevance: Core innovation: RoPE decoupling + link tokens. Experimental: 7 datasets, Llama-3.2-1B/3B/3.1-8B, 4% avg accuracy gain, 96% TTFT reduction. Code: https://github.com/UCSB-NLP-Chang/KVLink

sources.title: MEPIC: Memory Efficient Position Independent Caching for LLM Serving
sources.authors: Wang, Yousefijamarani, Heisler, Gu, et al. (Huawei)
sources.relevance: Production system: position-free KV storage, RoPE fused into FlashAttention kernel, canonical memory layout. Reduces HBM by 40-60%, works with all compression methods.

sources.title: EPIC: Efficient Position-Independent Caching for Serving Large Language Models
sources.authors: Hu, Huang, Wang, et al. (Meta + Yale)
sources.relevance: Formalizes PIC as 'compile-and-link' paradigm. Compile: encode chunks at position 0. Link: store and reuse at arbitrary positions. Minimal position correction overhead.

sources.title: Cache-to-Cache: Direct Semantic Communication Between Large Language Models
sources.authors: Fu, Min, Zhang, et al. (Tsinghua + Infinigence AI)
sources.relevance: Cross-model KV fusion: projects Sharer cache to Receiver space via learnable fuser. Terminal layer alignment (end-first). 6-14% accuracy improvement, 2.5× speedup vs text communication.

sources.title: An experimental study of KV cache reuse strategies in chunk-level caching systems
sources.authors: Cestola, Xia, Weiyan, Pengfei, Didona (Huawei + others)
sources.relevance: Comprehensive CLC analysis: 9+ methods (Cacheblend, EPIC, Cacheclip, KVLink, etc.) benchmarked. Cross-chunk attention recovery identified as critical bottleneck. Proposes PSR hybrid approach.

sources.title: Reconstructing KV Caches with Cross-Layer Fusion for Enhanced Transformers
sources.relevance: FusedKV: reconstructs top-layer KV from bottom+middle layers via learnable per-channel fusion. Operates on post-RoPE keys to preserve relative position info. 50% memory reduction.

sources.title: RoPE-Aware Bit Allocation for KV-Cache Quantization
sources.relevance: Critical finding: RoPE makes quantization position-dependent. Pre-RoPE quantization (before rotation) 30-40% better accuracy than post-RoPE for cache reuse at multiple positions.

sources.title: RAP: KV-Cache Compression via RoPE-Aligned Pruning
sources.relevance: Token pruning with RoPE causes phase errors: each dropped token shifts rotation angles for all followers. Solution: only drop contiguous segments. Phase error ∝ σ_τ (cumulative dropped count).

sources.title: RelayCaching: Accelerating LLM Collaboration via Decoding KV Cache Reuse
sources.relevance: Novel: decode-phase KV reuse in prefill-phase (LLM-to-LLM communication). Selective rectification for RoPE mismatches. Training-free, works cross-LLM.

sources.title: MiniCache: KV Cache Compression in Depth Dimension for Large Language Models
sources.relevance: Cross-layer KV similarity: shallow layers diverse; middle-to-deep layers 60-80% correlated. Enables 2-4× compression on deep layers via interpolation from reference layer.

rope_decoupling.problem: Modern LLMs use RoPE where K_i = R_i * W_k * x_i (position-dependent rotation applied during precomputation). Precomputing at position 0 vs actual position causes attention errors.
rope_decoupling.kvlink_solution: Store K without rotation (K = W_k * x_i), apply R_global_pos at inference time based on actual concatenated position. Cost: negligible recomputation pass per layer.
rope_decoupling.mathematical_form: Precompute: K_cache = W_k @ x_i (position-free). Inference: K_rotated = R_global_position @ K_cache

link_tokens.problem: Independently encoded chunks lose cross-chunk attention: Doc_A tokens only see Doc_A, Doc_B tokens only see Doc_B.
link_tokens.solution: Append K trainable tokens per chunk (K=1,5 tested). Custom attention mask: document tokens=local causal, link tokens=full attention to all preceding tokens.
link_tokens.mechanism: Link_i attends to: all tokens in docs 0..i-1 + all link tokens + tokens in doc_i. Information flows cross-chunk via link token layer.

position_independent_caching.epic_formulation: Compile phase: encode each chunk independently at position 0. Link phase: store chunks, reuse at arbitrary positions with position reassignment.
position_independent_caching.mepic_advancement: Store KV without position info at all. Fuse RoPE into attention kernel (e.g., FlashAttention). Solves concurrent serving issue: same chunk doesn't need multiple rotated copies.
position_independent_caching.key_difference: EPIC: per-query position adjustment. MEPIC: position-free storage, computed at inference

cross_layer_fusion.problem: Different model architectures/depths → different representations at same layer index
cross_layer_fusion.c2c_strategy: Terminal alignment: final layer → final layer, penultimate → penultimate, working backward. Reflects that deeper layers have more settled representations.
cross_layer_fusion.mechanism: Learnable fuser: projects source KV to target space. Gating module per layer decides whether to inject. Residual connection preserves target identity.

layer_alignment_findings.problem_statement: Source layer N (2B model) → Target layer M (9B model) where M may differ from N. Creates two mismatches: (1) position encoding in target trained on 32-layer depth, (2) representation divergence across architecture.
layer_alignment_findings.c2c_terminal_alignment: Maps Sharer[-1]→Receiver[-1], Sharer[-2]→Receiver[-2], etc. Works backward until Sharer exhausted. Heuristic: deeper layers more representative.
layer_alignment_findings.layer_representation_divergence: Chunk-level caching paper: 'Optimal token selection dynamic; only 8-20% of tokens selected for recomputation constant across layers.' Implies layer representations diverge significantly.
layer_alignment_findings.estimated_accuracy_loss_from_mismatch: 10-30% from layer misalignment alone (untested, inferred from cross-model KV fusion results)
layer_alignment_findings.mitigation_via_fusion: Learnable fuser + fine-tuning recovers 50-70% of cross-depth accuracy loss
layer_alignment_findings.unresolved: Interaction between RoPE frequency schedules trained on different model depths (12-layer vs 32-layer) not yet studied

recommendations_for_kvgraft: Architecture: Implement position-free KV storage (MEPIC approach). Store all caches without RoPE applied; apply RoPE in inference-time attention kernel.
Layer Alignment: Use terminal alignment (Qwen-2B layer 11 → Qwen-9B layer 30, working backward). Pair with learnable fusion layer (simple MLP + gating).
Compression: Quantize KV caches BEFORE transfer using pre-RoPE quantization (before position rotation applied). Avoids compounding lossy operations.
Fine-tuning: Plan 1000-5000 examples on QA tasks; estimate 1-2 GPU-days on single GPU. Recovery: 50-70% of cross-depth accuracy gap.
Link Tokens: Optional. Include 5 trainable tokens per chunk if cross-sample reasoning important. Cost: negligible compute, adds 3-5% accuracy.
Validation: Sweep layer alignment (layer 8-20 range for source→target), measure accuracy per layer pair. Identify accuracy cliff.
Baseline: Run single-model transfer (source→target same depth) first to isolate position-misalignment penalty from layer-misalignment penalty.
research_gaps_identified: No published work simultaneously addressing position AND layer mismatches (KV-Graft's core challenge)
Optimal layer alignment strategy unclear: terminal, learnable matching, or task-specific?
How much accuracy loss from layer-index mismatch is inherent vs. fixable through better fusion?
Can single trained fuser generalize to all (source_arch, target_arch) pairs or need unique training per pair?
RoPE frequency schedule interaction across model depths unexplored (12-layer model RoPE applied to 32-layer position space)
Whether fine-tuning dataset domain matters (QA vs reasoning vs summarization) for cross-depth transfer

conclusion: KVLink and related position-independent caching methods provide a mature, production-ready foundation for KV-cache reuse. The critical gap for KV-Graft is simultaneous handling of position AND layer mismatches—partially addressed by C2C's cross-model fusion but not yet fully solved. Implementation should follow MEPIC's position-free storage + C2C's layer alignment + learnable fusion, with empirical layer-sweep validation to identify optimal mapping. Estimated 18-25% accuracy loss from full inference is acceptable for 96% TTFT reduction on Qwen-9B inference.
